limitations_and_boundaries: Female TauP301S mice showed subtler neurodegeneration at 9 months, and effects of C3KO could not be resolved.
TauP301S mice did not show robust impairment in Morris water maze, so effect of C3KO on cognitive impairment could not be assessed.
The partial rescue of neurodegeneration was not associated with significant reduction in tau pathology or prevention of gliosis.
Microglial synapse engulfment reduction in TauP301SxC3KO was not significant.
C3 levels in EAD lysates and PSDs were not significantly different from controls.
